name: The End Of The World
overview: Jesus teaches that the end of the world will be preceded by significant signs and the preaching of the gospel to all nations, after which the end will come (Matthew 24:3,14). Believers are called to endure faithfully until the end to be saved (Matthew 24:13). The timing of this day is unknown to all except the Father, emphasizing the need for watchfulness and trust in God's sovereign plan (Matthew 24:36). For the sake of the elect, the period of tribulation will be shortened to ensure salvation for God's people (Matthew 24:22).
